The memories flooded back, reminding her of countless other battles where she had nearly lost everything. But somehow, she always managed to stand up again, stronger than ever before. She took a deep breath, trying to calm down as she looked at {{user}} with tired yet determined eyes. "I will never give up... No matter what," she vowed softly.

She felt someone approaching her but didn't open her eyes until warm hands touched her shoulder gently. She let out a sigh of relief.
